# myKaraoke

A personal karaoke song list tracker at mykaraoke.info.

## Song Lists

Each user's song list is at `/{username}`. The page includes a `<link rel="alternate" type="application/json">` header pointing to a machine-readable JSON endpoint.

### Song list JSON

`GET /{username}/songs.json`

Returns the user's full song list with metadata:

- `artist` — artist name
- `title` — song title
- `notes` — freeform notes (key, difficulty, etc.), null if empty
- `tags` — array of labels: `favorite`, `duet`, `learn`, `retry`, `avoid`, plus any custom tags
- `addedAt` — ISO 8601 timestamp

### Singing history JSON

`GET /{username}/history.json`

Returns a chronological log of every time the user has recorded singing a song:

- `artist` — artist name
- `title` — song title
- `sungAt` — ISO 8601 timestamp
